title: Which Pokémon are you? Pokémon type personality quiz — cv.cm
description: Free Pokémon personality quiz: answer 12 questions to find your Pokémon type (Fire, Water, Grass, Electric, Psychic, Fairy, Dragon, Ghost, Fighting or Normal) and the partner Pokémon that matches you. No sign-up.
lede: Are you a Fire-type with a short fuse, a laid-back Normal-type or a mischievous Ghost? Answer 12 everyday questions to find your Pokémon type and a partner Pokémon that shares your personality.
about: Each Pokémon type has a personality fans recognize at once: Fire is bold and passionate, Water goes with the flow, Grass is patient and nurturing, Ghost is mischievous. This quiz looks at how you spend your time, handle stress and treat your friends, and scores ten of the eighteen types.

Your result names the type you match best, a partner Pokémon to go with it and your scores for every type. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo, Creatures, GAME FREAK or The Pokémon Company; the names belong to their owners.

faq.q: How many Pokémon types are there?
faq.a: Eighteen: Normal, Fire, Water, Grass, Electric, Ice, Fighting, Poison, Ground, Flying, Psychic, Bug, Rock, Ghost, Dragon, Dark, Steel and Fairy. This quiz uses the ten with the clearest personalities.
Your result gives a partner Pokémon for your type, such as Pikachu for Electric or Eevee for Normal, plus two more Pokémon of the same type that fit the same personality.

faq.q: Is this an official Pokémon quiz?
faq.a: No. It is a free fan quiz for fun. Nothing you answer is saved or sent anywhere.

faq.q: Why did I get a type I didn't expect?
faq.a: The quiz scores how you describe your habits, not your favorite Pokémon. If two types are close, the result also shows the runner-up; retake it on another day and see whether it changes.

fire.name: Fire type · partner: Charmander
fire.body: Passionate, bold and impossible to ignore. You throw yourself into everything and your enthusiasm is contagious, though your temper can flare as fast as it cools. Fellow Fire types: Arcanine and Cyndaquil.

water.name: Water type · partner: Squirtle
water.body: Calm, adaptable and easy to be around. You go with the flow, smooth over arguments and find a way around obstacles instead of through them. Fellow Water types: Vaporeon and Piplup.

grass.name: Grass type · partner: Bulbasaur
grass.body: Patient, steady and quietly nurturing. You grow slowly but surely, look after the people around you and feel most like yourself outdoors. Fellow Grass types: Leafeon and Rowlet.

electric.name: Electric type · partner: Pikachu
electric.body: Quick, bright and full of energy. You think fast, act faster and bring a spark to every room, but sitting still is hard for you. Fellow Electric types: Jolteon and Pachirisu.

psychic.name: Psychic type · partner: Espeon
psychic.body: Intuitive and thoughtful. You read people and situations before anyone speaks, and you prefer a clever plan to brute force. Fellow Psychic types: Gardevoir and Mew.

fairy.name: Fairy type · partner: Sylveon
fairy.body: Kind, charming and warm. You make people feel welcome and cared for, and there is more strength behind your gentleness than people expect. Fellow Fairy types: Clefairy and Togepi.

dragon.name: Dragon type · partner: Dragonite
dragon.body: Ambitious, proud and determined. You aim higher than anyone else and have the stubbornness to get there, with a soft spot for the few people you trust. Fellow Dragon types: Garchomp and Axew.

ghost.name: Ghost type · partner: Gengar
ghost.body: Mysterious and mischievous. You come alive at night, love a good prank and have a sense of humor people either adore or don't get. Fellow Ghost types: Mimikyu and Litwick.

fighting.name: Fighting type · partner: Lucario
fighting.body: Disciplined, loyal and protective. You train hard, keep your word and stand up for your friends without being asked. Fellow Fighting types: Riolu and Machop.

normal.name: Normal type · partner: Eevee
normal.body: Easygoing, adaptable and full of potential. You are comfortable with yourself, get along with almost anyone and never say no to a snack or a nap. Fellow Normal types: Snorlax and Jigglypuff.
